body: Regulated enterprises (defense, banking, national infrastructure) require completely air-gapped sovereign installations of Product Forge with zero outbound internet connectivity. This item authors the sovereign edition packaging specification.
_note: Full authoring of context, epic, and ACs

brief.problem: Defense, finance, and air-gapped sovereign environments cannot reach external LLM APIs or cloud licensing servers, requiring self-contained offline execution capabilities.
brief.what_adds: Air-Gapped Sovereign Edition Specification: offline model connector, local RAG vector bundle, and offline license validation.

label: PF Backlog 689
risks: Hardware acceleration requirements for local model inference mitigated via documentation of minimal GPU/CPU specs.
title: Air-Gapped Sovereign Edition Specification: offline model connector, local RAG vector bundle, and offline license validation
summary: Author the architecture and packaging specification for an air-gapped sovereign edition, including offline model connectors, pre-indexed local RAG knowledge bundles, and cryptographic offline license key verification.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_model_override.py, core/business_models_kb.py, core/ci_cd_model.py, core/conversation_models.py

approach: Define sovereign edition profile in EDITIONS, validate zero outbound network calls in pre-flight checks, and bundle offline licensing keys.
rollback: Fall back to standard on-prem edition profile.
objective: Specify and package the Sovereign Edition distribution capable of operating with 100% network isolation and local compute resources.

api_impact.reason: Packaging, deployment, and verification CLI/core capability; no dedicated HTTP routes required

verification: Air-gap network isolation test suite executing full workflow in simulated offline network namespace.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Sovereign edition distribution operates with zero outbound network egress, validated via fail-closed egress monitor.
AC-2: Embedded offline licensing engine validates cryptographically signed license keys without phoning home or requiring NTP clock sync.
AC-3: Local LLM runtime integrates embedded Ollama/llama.cpp inference socket with bundled domain model weights.
